UPDATE=012
SOURCE_COMMIT="8fff057"
ARCHIVE_SHA256=7be8789eb27282834d4539e10cf7de91a9cd06236e9b51ee31f95bd651416b48
FILES=169
PAYLOAD_SHA256=92edea61b8a996e939c18c6ceb1620d39f3619949740b7cfd206bf1272c79cc9
[ -f "$0" ] || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=run-from-file"; exit 1; }
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=usage: sh /path/to/daemon-linux-012.txt /absolute/dir"; exit 1; }
DEST=$1
case "$DEST" in /*|[A-Za-z]:/*) ;; *) echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=absolute required"; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=target-already-exists:$DEST — run: rm -rf $DEST"; exit 1; fi
for c in base64 tar sha256sum mktemp; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=missing:$c"; exit 1; }; done
TMP=$(mktemp -d) || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=mktemp"; exit 1; }
b64d() { base64 -d "$1" 2>/dev/null || base64 -D "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
sed -n '/^__DAEMON_LINUX_012_PAYLOAD__$/,$p' "$0" | tail -n +2 > "$TMP/b64_raw.txt"
grep -v '^#' "$TMP/b64_raw.txt" | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' > "$TMP/b64.txt"
b64d "$TMP/b64.txt" > "$TMP/src.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=base64"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
GOT=$(sha256sum "$TMP/src.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "$ARCHIVE_SHA256" ]; then echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=archive-sha want=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 got=$GOT"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; fi

tar -xzf "$TMP/src.tar.gz" -C "$DEST" || { echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=tar"; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit 1; }
rm -rf "$TMP"
GOT2=$(cd "$DEST" && find . -type f | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2"
if [ "$GOT2" != "$PAYLOAD_SHA256" ]; then echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_FAIL=payload-sha want=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 got=$GOT2"; exit 1; fi
echo "DAEMON_LINUX_012_DONE=YES"
ls -lh "$DEST/assets/daemon.desktop" 2>&1 | head -n 5
echo "Next: sh $DEST/setup.sh"
echo "--- inverse ---"
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_WANT=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT PAYLOAD_SHA256_WANT=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2 FILES=$FILES DEST=$DEST"
